65902-tomorrow-the-world.title: Tomorrow The World
65902-tomorrow-the-world.creator: Unknown

I halted indecisively, growled at myself, and went on. I had a perfectly valid excuse for being there. They could hardly do anything to me.

arxiv-2012-15349.title: DynaSent: A Dynamic Benchmark for Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2012-15349.creator: Christopher PottsStanford University cgpotts@stanford.edu, Zhengxuan WuStanford University wuzhengx@stanford.edu Atticus GeigerStanford University atticusg@stanford.edu Douwe KielaFacebook AI Research dkiela@fb.com
arxiv-2012-15349.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Christopher PottsStanford University cgpotts@stanford.edu, Zhengxuan WuStanford University wuzhengx@stanford.edu Atticus GeigerStanford University atticusg@stanford.edu Douwe KielaFacebook AI Research dkiela@fb.com. We introduce DynaSent (‘Dynamic Sentiment’), a new English-language benchmark task for ternary (positive/negative/neutral) sentiment analysis. DynaSent combines naturally occurring sentences with sentences created using the open-source Dynabench Platform, which facilities human-and-model-in-the-loop dataset creation.

arxiv-2209-04183.title: Generative Deformable Radiance Fields for Disentangled Image Synthesis of Topology-Varying Objects Volume: 41 Issue: 7
arxiv-2209-04183.creator: Ziyu Wang 1 , Yu Deng 2,3 , Jiaolong Yang 3 , Jingyi Yu 1 and Xin Tong 3 1 ShanghaiTech University, 2 Tsinghua University, 3 Microsoft Research Asia
arxiv-2209-04183.description: Abstract 3D-aware generative models have demonstrated their superb performance to generate 3D neural radiance fields (NeRF) from a collection of monocular 2D images even for topology-varying object categories. However, these methods still lack the capability to separately control the shape and appearance of the objects in the generated radiance fields.

arxiv-2303-10233.title: Fast solution of incompressible flow problems with two-level pressure approximation Thanks: Acknowledgements. This work was supported by EPSRC grant EP/W033801/1.
arxiv-2303-10233.creator: Jennifer Pestana, David J. Silvester
arxiv-2303-10233.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jennifer Pestana, David J. Silvester. This paper develops efficient preconditioned iterative solvers for incompressible flow problems discretised by an enriched Taylor–Hood mixed approximation, in which the usual pressure space is augmented by a piecewise constant pressure to ensure local mass conservation. This enrichment process causes over-specification of the pressure when the pressure space is defined by the union of standard Taylor–Hood basis functions and piecewise constant pressure basis functions, which complicates the design and implementation of efficient solvers for the resulting linear systems.

arxiv-2303-11061.description: Abstract We study the convergence of Bernstein type operators leading to two results. The first: The kernel K n K_{n} of the Bernstein-Durrmeyer operator at each point x ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) x\in(0,1) — that is K n ​ ( x , t ) ​ d ​ t K_{n}(x,t)dt — once standardised converges to the normal distribution.

arxiv-2402-08087.title: Nonperturbative Simulation of Anharmonic Rattler Dynamics in Type-I Clathrates with Vibrational Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
arxiv-2402-08087.creator: Dipti Jasrasaria, Timothy C. Berkelbach
arxiv-2402-08087.description: Abstract We use vibrational dynamical mean-field theory (VDMFT) to study the vibrational structure of type-I clathrate solids, specifically X 8 Ga 16 Ge 30 , where X=Ba,Sr. These materials are cage-like chemical structures hosting loosely bound guest atoms, resulting in strong anharmonicity, short phonon lifetimes, and ultra-low thermal conductivities.

arxiv-2501-01789.title: The ESO SupJup Survey IV. Unveiling the carbon isotope ratio of GQ Lup B and its host star
arxiv-2501-01789.creator: D. González Picos, I.A.G. Snellen, S. de Regt, R. Landman, Y. Zhang, S. Gandhi, A. Sánchez-López
arxiv-2501-01789.description: Abstract Context. The carbon isotope ratio ( 12 C/ 13 C) is a potential tracer of giant planet and brown dwarf formation. The GQ Lup system, which hosts the K7 T Tauri star GQ Lup A and its substellar companion GQ Lup B, provides a unique opportunity to investigate 12 C/ 13 C in a young system. Aims.

arxiv-2505-04579.title: Implicitly Aligning Humans and Autonomous Agents through Shared Task Abstractions
arxiv-2505-04579.creator: Stéphane Aroca-OuelletteMiguel Aroca-Ouellette, Katharina von der Wense, Alessandro Roncone
arxiv-2505-04579.description: Abstract In collaborative tasks, autonomous agents fall short of humans in their capability to quickly adapt to new and unfamiliar teammates. We posit that a limiting factor for zero-shot coordination is the lack of shared task abstractions, a mechanism humans rely on to implicitly align with teammates.

arxiv-2505-10291.title: Density perturbations in nonminimally coupled gravity: symptoms of Lagrangian density ambiguity
arxiv-2505-10291.creator: Miguel Barroso Varela, Orfeu Bertolami
arxiv-2505-10291.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Miguel Barroso Varela, Orfeu Bertolami. The evolution of density perturbations is analysed in a modified theory of gravity with a nonminimal coupling between curvature and matter. We consider the broken degeneracy between the choices of matter Lagrangian for a perfect fluid, ℒ m = − ρ \mathcal{L}_{m}=-\rho and ℒ m = p \mathcal{L}_{m}=p , and determine the differences between their effects on the effective gravitational constant.

arxiv-2509-07387.title: Dynamic Redeployment of Nurses Across Hospitals: A Sample Robust Optimization Approach
arxiv-2509-07387.creator: Wei Liu, Tianchun Li, Mengshi Lu, Pengyi Shi
arxiv-2509-07387.description: Abstract Problem definition: We study a workforce redeployment problem in hospital networks, where clinical staff, such as nurses, are temporarily reassigned from overstaffed to understaffed sites to address short-term imbalances. This practice of “internal travel,” which gained traction during the COVID-19 pandemic to tackle nurse shortages, presents new operational challenges that require tailored analytical support.

pmc-10696783.title: Genetic and clinical landscape of ER + /PR- breast cancer in China
pmc-10696783.creator: Danian Dai, Hongmei Wu, Hongkai Zhuang, Rong Chen, Cheng Long, Bo Chen
pmc-10696783.description: BackgroundEstrogen receptor-positive and progesterone receptor-negative (ER + /PR-) breast cancer comprise a special type. More than 10% breast cancer patients belonged to ER + /PR-.MethodsIn order to better understand this patient population, we utilized a unique dataset from China, examining the clinicopathological features and genomic profiles of ER + /PR- breast cancers.

pmc-10721265.title: Inflammation-induced TRIM21 represses hepatic steatosis by promoting the ubiquitination of lipogenic regulators
pmc-10721265.creator: Kostas C Nikolaou, Svenja Godbersen, Muthiah Manoharan, Stefan Wieland, Markus H Heim, Markus Stoffel
pmc-10721265.description: Nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) is a leading cause for chronic liver diseases. Current therapeutic options are limited due to an incomplete mechanistic understanding of how steatosis transitions to NASH. Here we show that the TRIM21 E3 ubiquitin ligase is induced by the synergistic actions of proinflammatory TNF-α and fatty acids in livers of humans and mice with NASH.

pmc-11545871.title: Assessing the Efficacy of Lokomat Training in Pediatric Physiotherapy for Cerebral Palsy: A Progress Evaluation
pmc-11545871.creator: Michalina Błażkiewicz, Anna Hadamus
pmc-11545871.description: Background: Gait disturbances in children with cerebral palsy can increase the hindrance caused by loss of independence and social engagement. The Lokomat, developed by Hocoma, shows promise as a supplementary tool for gait rehabilitation. This study investigates the impact of Lokomat training on gait parameters and trends observed during training.

pmc-11606938.title: Stress fiber strain is zero in normal aortic smooth muscle, elevated in hypertensive stretch, and minimal in wall thickening rats
pmc-11606938.creator: Shukei Sugita, Rintaro Kawai, Yoshihiro Ujihara, Masanori Nakamura
pmc-11606938.description: Hypertension causes aortic wall thickening until the original wall stress is restored. We hypothesized that this regulation involves stress fiber (SF) tension transmission to the nucleus in smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and investigated the strain in the SF direction as a condition required for this transmission. Thoracic aortas from Wistar Kyoto (WKY) and spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs) were examined.

pmc-11644257.title: Evaluation of the Leaves and Seeds of Cucurbitaceae Plants as a New Source of Bioactive Compounds for Colorectal Cancer Prevention and Treatment
pmc-11644257.creator: Mercedes Peña, Ana Guzmán, Cristina Mesas, Jesús M. Porres, Rosario Martínez, Francisco Bermúdez, Consolación Melguizo, Laura Cabeza, Jose Prados
pmc-11644257.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives: The Cucurbitaceae family represents an important source of bioactive compounds with antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory and antitumor activities. This study aims to investigate the potential application of Cucurbitaceae leaves and seed extracts to prevent and treat colorectal cancer (CRC). Methods: Four extracts (ethanol extracts and protein extracts and hydrolysates) from the leaves and seeds of cucurbits were tested in T-84, HCT-15 and HT-29 CRC cells. The antitumor, antiangiogenic, antioxidant and chemopreventive potentials and bioactive composition of the active extracts were characterized.

pmc-12463642.title: FAST—framework for AI-based surgical transformation
pmc-12463642.creator: Harmehr Sekhon, Farid Al Zoubi, Paul E. Beaulé, Pascal Fallavollita
pmc-12463642.description: BackgroundThe use of machine learning (ML) in surgery till date has largely focused on predication of surgical variables, which has not been found to significantly improve operating room efficiencies and surgical success rates (SSR). Due to the long surgery wait times, limited health care resources and an increased population need, innovative ML models are needed.

pmc-12579831.title: Predictive Value of the COP-INH Score for Adverse Cardiovascular Events After PCI in ACS Patients
pmc-12579831.creator: Junping Ou, Zhongwen Liu, Qingyi Wang, Yuping Wang, Xiaolin Li
pmc-12579831.description: BackgroundPatients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) require long-term antiplatelet therapy to prevent in-stent restenosis. However, the efficacy of this treatment can be compromised by factors, such as aspirin resistance and variable clopidogrel reactivity, potentially leading to adverse clinical outcomes.

pmc-13239790.title: Quadratus Lumborum Block Reduced Postpartum Uterine Pain After Normal Spontaneous Delivery: A Prospective, Randomized, Double‐Blind, Controlled Trial
pmc-13239790.creator: Wen‐Shan Cheng, Yen‐Tin Chen, Wei‐Hsiang Chao, Chia‐Chih Liao
pmc-13239790.description: Background and AimsNormal spontaneous delivery is often accompanied by various types of pain; postpartum uterine pain can persist for 2 or 3 days after childbirth. The quadratus lumborum block (QLB) is a relatively safe, cost‐effective, and efficacious pain management strategy used in various abdominal surgeries.

pmc-13337221.creator: Olga Maria Nardone, Giulio Calabrese, Alexander C Ford, Fabiana Castiglione, Edoardo Vincenzo Savarino, Vipul Jairath, Yuhong Yuan, Silvio Danese, Tommaso Lorenzo Parigi, Brigida Barberio

pmc-13676625.title: Valorization of Beetroot and Watermelon by-Products as Functional Ingredients Targeting Nitric Oxide Pathways: Implications for Cardiovascular Health
pmc-13676625.creator: Thiago Silveira Alvares
pmc-13676625.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Purpose of the ReviewFood loss and waste represent major challenges for food systems, while fruit and vegetable by-products generated during processing are underused sources of bioactive compounds with potential applications in functional food development. The present review aims to examine the valorization of beetroot and watermelon by-products as functional ingredients associated with nitric oxide (NO) bioavailability, vascular function, and cardiovascular health.
